_comment: The only place that lists models, effort levels and the simple-mode profiles. Verified against Claude Code 2.1.296 (`claude --help`: --model <alias|full name>, --effort low|medium|high|xhigh|max) and against this account's login on 2026-10-12: fable, opus, sonnet and haiku all answered. Policy: opus is the maximum for roles, agents and the planner; models in override_only (fable) can never be saved in a role, a template or the settings and are never a default: they exist only as a per-run override chosen in the UI, which asks for an explicit confirmation. Edit this file when the CLI or the subscription changes; the server rejects anything not listed here.
